question: What placement at the thumb tip results in the mudrā proclaimed as mahāyoni?
premises: Something is placed on the tip of the thumb.
The resulting mudrā is proclaimed as mahāyoni.
inference: Placing at the thumb tip constitutes the mudrā called mahāyoni.
uncertainties: The object placed at the thumb tip is not explicitly specified in this line.
plain_english: Having placed at the tip of the thumb, this is proclaimed as the Mahāyoni mudrā.
